verdict.rationale: Loops documents a single Bearer API key for authentication, but nothing in the evidence describes scoped, read-only, or permission-limited credentials that would let an agent or contractor read analytics without being able to send. The CLI's multi-team auth only switches between workspaces and does not limit permissions, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can mint scoped or read-only API credentials so an agent or contractor can read analytics without the power to send
